1.0.0: Initial release: Qlik Cloud apps (find, get, create, update, copy, publish, delete), reloads (reload and wait for the result, get, find, cancel), reports (generate a PDF, PowerPoint or PNG of a sheet or visualization), spaces (find, get, create, update, delete), data files (upload, find, delete), users (find, get, invite), automations (find, run and wait for the result), Reload Finished, New App, App Deleted and New User webhook triggers, and Make API Call. Connect with an API key or with an OAuth client (machine-to-machine); Reload App fails on a reload that does not succeed unless turned off; Upload Data File streams the file, checks the upload limits first and sends files over 500 MB through temporary content.
